## Copyright and content sources

Nuvio ReSeq is an independent media player and IPTV integration app. It does not host, supply or distribute movies, series, live broadcasts, IPTV subscriptions or playlists, or bundle third-party addons that supply those playback streams. Users configure playback sources and are responsible for compliance with applicable copyright laws, licensing requirements and provider terms. Default Cinemeta metadata and OpenSubtitles v3 subtitle endpoints, plus metadata/trailer/sports services, are separate from those playback sources. The project does not endorse or encourage infringement. Third-party names identify compatibility and attribution; they do not imply affiliation or endorsement. [Details and rights concerns](https://github.com/abbaskip/Nuvio-ReSeq#copyright-content-sources-and-independence).

## Credits and source

An independent fork of [Nuvio by Tapframe and contributors](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioTV), incorporating substantial work from [Nuvio + IPTV by homelessbrian and contributors](https://github.com/homelessbrian/NuvioPlusIPTV). Neither upstream project endorses ReSeq. Stalker interoperability includes MIT-licensed adaptations from [IPTVnator](https://github.com/4gray/iptvnator). Source is available at this release's tag under GPLv3, with existing copyright and third-party notices retained. See LICENSE, NOTICE-IPTV.md and NOTICE-IPTVNATOR.md at that tag. This content-source notice adds no licence restrictions.
